# Education Post

> > Education Post is India's comprehensive education news portal covering academic institutions, technology in education, policy developments, and global educational trends.

Education Post delivers news and insights on Indian education systems, institutional rankings, technology integration in learning, and policy initiatives. The platform covers developments from premier institutions like IIMs, technological advancements including AI in education, and education diplomacy.

## Key Topics

- Indian Education
- IIM Rohtak
- IIRF Ranking
- Technology in Education
- Artificial Intelligence
- India AI Policy
- National Science Day
- PM Modi
- Education News
- Tech Diplomacy
- Semiconductor Alliance
- Responsible AI
- OpenAI
- Education Portal

## Technology & Innovation

- [Technology: Education Post](https://educationpost.in/technology?page=1): Technology news covering AI, PM Modi, OpenAI, and National Science Day
